I’ve been a patient here for almost five years and the receptionists are horrendous. Every time I phone up I pretty much feel I would be better off dead as it wouldn’t be taking up their time. It’s as degrading as visiting a job centre when you’re unemployed. Literally you go to both for help not for fun!! I put several complaints in to the practice manager to be batted away and cock ups after cock ups have happened with receptionists and their attitudes. I’m not going to put my health on display here but there is literally no care from any of them and the last person to take my blood bruised my arm for over a week. The prescription service is a joke and they rarely make it down to the pharmacist (who are the complete opposite and I can’t praise enough). An absolute shame as the majority of doctors I’ve seen in the surgery have been lovely, particularly doctor ganderton, Davies and Blythe. I even came here from kings Road after their terrible service! AVOID!

Read previous reviews and notice the pattern. If you have mental health problems (anxiety, depression) the receptionists here are not geared up to help or even make your symptoms worse so I’m not alone!",null,[0,232]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNnNU5yZjFBRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x2e4acfb585a76591!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgMCg5Nrf1AE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNnNU5yZjFBRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNnNU5yZjFBRRItChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNnNU5yZk5BEhNDZ3dJLWVxTHZ3WVFzSjJad3dFGi0KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdNQ2c1TnJmdEFFEhJDZ3NJXzY2OHZRWVF5SzdqY0EiEgkAAAAAAAAAABGRZaeFtc9KLioTQ2d3SS1lcUx2d1lRc0oyWnd3RQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi7sO6t07CTAxXLJ2MBHSySKmYQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi7sO6t07CTAxXLJ2MBHSySKmYQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUpKZUdOZlgxOWZSV2hEY1doRWJIZzVaMm8wVWt0VFRXWnVNRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpoUlVOaGFrWjRTR0kwV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJeGZxS0pnEAE",["0x0:0x2e4acfb585a76591",null,1744385520861292,1744385520861292,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117549634457214290122/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Abigail Simmons","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUemS4h7ECV0oOdeoThhlL_vxZqNZJHCi2kMODNQb20kIGr3MIa=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117549634457214290122?hl=en"],"117549634457214290122",null,3,0,null,[0,3,1],1,["3 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi7sO6t07CTAxXLJ2MBHSySKmYQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"11 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["While the newer reception staff occasionally need some help when they're unfamiliar with a service/process, the doctors and nurses at the practice are without a doubt the best I've experienced anywhere I've lived.
